name: app-red-black-crypto-app-screens-on-dark-red-vignette
title: Red and Black Crypto Screens on Dark Vignette
whatItIs: A dark red vignette board with a headline 'All your crypto tools in one app' and seven phones in a scattered grid: transaction history, deposit QR, swap, wallet chart, portfolio risk score and a send keypad, alternating black and red screens.
whatItMeans: Alternating red and black screens create rhythm, and the vignette keeps the board dramatic.
techniques: Red striped chart as a signature texture
Consistent pill tab bar across screens

vocabulary.definition: Phones scattered in staggered columns on one board.
A presentation with a darkened edge gradient.
